'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Arab countries]]
****[[2026 Iranian strikes on Bahrain]]
*****[[Bahrain]]'s [[Bahrain Defence Force|military]] says that they have intercepted a number of [[Ballistic missile program of Iran|missiles]] and [[Unmanned aerial vehicles in the Iranian military|drones]] from [[Iran]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2652109/middle-east (''Arab News'')]
****[[2026 Iranian strikes on Jordan]]
*****[[Jordan]]'s [[Jordan Armed Forces|military]] says that they have intercepted seven missiles and six drones launched from Iran. No casualties or damage were reported. [https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/07/jordan-intercepts-7-missiles-6-drones-iran-warns-civilians-near-us-bases (''Al-Monitor'')]
****[[2026 Iranian strikes on Kuwait]]
*****[[Kuwait]]'s [[Kuwait Army|army]] says that its air defenses confronted several attacks from Iran. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2652109/middle-east (Arab News)]
****[[Iran]] says it has attacked [[U.S. military bases]] in Bahrain, Jordan, and Kuwait, including the [[Isa Air Base]], using [[Arash (drone)|Arash]] drones. [https://www.euronews.com/2026/07/24/iran-military-says-it-targeted-us-bases-in-bahrain-jordan-and-kuwait (Euronews)]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****[[2026 United States naval blockade of Iran]]
*****The [[U.S. military]] says its forces fired into a [[Tanker (ship)|tanker]]'s [[engine room]] and disabled the vessel after its crew repeatedly attempted to breach the American [[blockade]] of [[List of ports in Iran|Iranian ports]] and ignored warnings. [https://www.bssnews.net/news-flash/408670 (AFP via BSS)]
****The [[List of diplomatic missions of India|Indian embassy]] in [[Tehran]] reports that the [[Mozambique]]-flagged [[Liquefied petroleum gas|LPG]] [[Gas carrier|tanker]] ''Disha'' with 28 Indian nationals on the vessel was [[List of ships attacked during the 2026 Iran war|attacked]] in the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. All 28 crew members were reported safe. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/lpg-tanker-with-indians-aboard-attacked-in-iran-waters-crew-disha-vessel-mozambique-embassy-us-war-101784913031254.html (''The Hindustan Times'')] [https://www.indiatoday.in/world/story/lpg-tanker-attack-iranian-waters-28-indian-crew-safe-strait-of-hormuz-2955742-2026-07-25 (''India Today'')]
***[[July 2026 United States strikes against Iran]]
****The [[United States]] strikes an [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy]] naval academy in [[Ziba Kenar]], [[Gilan province]], Iran. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2652109/middle-east (Arab News)] [https://www.iranintl.com/en/202607248712 (Iran International)]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on the Kurdistan Region]]
****Drones target [[Erbil]] in [[Iraq]]'s [[Kurdistan Region]], with six drones reported to be intercepted. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-us-hormuz-strait-war-24-july-2026-78c2dbf538f6e61ab816479a4d9bdd85 (AP)] [https://www.kurdistan24.net/en/story/927857/six-explosive-laden-drones-intercepted-over-erbil (Kurdistan24)]
***''[[The Wall Street Journal]]'' reports that [[Royal Bahraini Air Force|Bahraini]] and [[Kuwait Air Force|Kuwaiti]] [[fighter jet]]s attacked military targets inside Iran earlier in July, with air and intelligence support from the [[United Arab Emirates Air Force|United Arab Emirates]]. [https://www.wsj.com/world/middle-east/iran-gulf-states-bahrain-kuwait-strikes-009637db (''The Wall Street Journal'')] [https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-903577 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
**[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
***[[Gaza war]]
****The [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli military]] reports that the [[Israeli Air Force|air force]] has struck [[Hamas]] weapon depots, weapon manufacturing sites and [[Tunnel warfare in the Gaza Strip|tunnels]] in the [[Gaza Strip]], and accuses the militant group of violating the [[ceasefire]] signed in [[Gaza peace plan|October 2025]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/air-force-bombed-hamas-tunnels-weapons-depots-manufacturing-sites-in-gaza-idf/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***[[July 2026 West Bank unrest]]
****Clashes in [[Tell, Nablus]], kill four [[Palestinians]] and two [[Israelis]] after a confrontation between [[Israeli settlers|settlers]] and locals in the town. Subsequent [[Israeli settler violence|settler attacks]] in the [[West Bank]] injure at least 10 Palestinians. [https://www.haaretz.com/west-bank/2026-07-24/ty-article/.premium/israeli-settler-raids-wound-ten-palestinians-after-deadly-west-bank-clashes/0000019f-941b-dad9-abbf-bd7bb6540000 (''Haaretz'')] [https://www.nytimes.com/2026/07/24/world/middleeast/west-bank-shooting-tell-israelis-palestinians.html (''The New York Times'')]
**[[Red Sea crisis]], [[Saudi-led intervention in the Yemeni civil war]]
***The [[Houthis]] deny reports that they have closed the [[Bab-el-Mandeb]] and state that they are not seeking to close it, reaffirming that they have only established a naval blockade against [[Saudi Arabia]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/yemens-houthis-deny-they-closed-bab-al-mandeb-strait/live-78093040 (DW)] [https://www.middleeasteye.net/live-blog/live-blog-update/houthi-spokesperson-says-naval-blockade-bab-el-mandeb-only-against-saudi (''Middle East Eye'')]
***[[Saudi Arabia]] strikes [[Houthi]] military sites in [[Hodeidah]], [[Yemen]], after a long hiatus in response to the movement's attacks on maritime shipping, while the militant group vows to retaliate. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/saudi-strikes-target-yemens-hodeidah-says-houthi-run-al-masirah-tv-2026-07-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***[[Ukrainian strikes on Wildberries warehouses]]
****A [[Wildberries]] logistic hub in [[Russian occupation of Crimea|Russia-occupied]] [[Crimea]] is hit by [[Unmanned Systems Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian drones]] and catches fire. [https://newsukraine.rbc.ua/news/crimea-attack-sets-wildberries-warehouse-1784851315.html (RBC-Ukraine)]
****Ukrainian drones also hit Wildberries logistics hubs in [[Saint Petersburg]] and [[Tver]], [[Russia]]. [https://kyivindependent.com/wildberries-logistics-center-in-russian-occupied-crimea-catches-fire-after-reported-drone-strike/ (''Kyiv Independent'')]
**[[Kyiv strikes (2022–present)|Kyiv strikes]]
***[[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] officials say a Russian [[ballistic missile]] strike on a private training ground hosting a [[Defense industry of Ukraine|defence-industry]] event in the [[Kyiv Oblast]] killed 10 people and injured nearly 100. Prosecutors investigate possible negligence in organizing the event. [https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/russian-missile-strike-kills-10-ukraine-defence-event-2026-07-24/ (Reuters)]
**[[Violations of non-combatant airspace during the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Violations of non-combatant airspace during the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***A [[Romanian Air Force|Romanian]] [[F-16]] ​[[fighter jet]] shot down a Russian [[HESA Shahed 136|Geran-2]] drone near [[Padina, Buzău|Padina]], [[Buzău County]], that had entered its [[airspace]] for the first ‌time. [https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2026/07/24/romania-says-f-16-jet-shot-down-a-drone-over-its-airspace (Euronews)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Kordofan campaign (2023–present)|Kordofan campaign]]
***The [[North Kordofan]] government reports that 15 civilians in the Burbur area south of [[El-Obeid]], [[Sudan]] have been killed by a [[Rapid Support Forces]] drone strike. [https://sudantribune.com/article/316572 (''Sudan Tribune'')]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**At least 27 people are killed, including 12 militants, in an attack on a security check post in [[Tank District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/15-killed-in-militant-attack-on-security-check-post-in-north-west-pakistan-says-military-101784901776522.html (''Hindustan Times'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Tariffs in the second Trump administration]]
**[[2025–2026 United States trade war with Canada and Mexico]]
***The [[Gordie Howe International Bridge]], which [[Detroit–Windsor|connects]] between [[Detroit]], [[Michigan]], U.S., and [[Windsor, Ontario]], [[Canada]], ceremonially opens, with Canadian officials marking the opening ceremony of the bridge with the absence of American officials amidst ongoing trade tensions. Discovery]] amidst lawsuits from twelve [[State attorney general|U.S. state attorneys general]]. '''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Wildfires in 2026]]
**[[2026 France wildfires]]
***[[France|French]] [[French Civil Protection|authorities]] evacuate more than 110,000 people from [[Cap Ferret]], [[Gironde]], by land and sea as an uncontrolled [[wildfire]] burns over 19,000 hectares, destroys 80 homes, and threatens the peninsula’s only [[access road]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jul/24/france-evacuation-cap-ferret-peninsula-wildfire (''The Guardian'')]
**[[2026 Spain wildfires]]
***[[Spain|Spanish]] [[Ministry of the Interior (Spain)|interior minister]] [[Fernando Grande-Marlaska]] declares a [[national emergency]] over [[wildfire]]s in the [[Community of Madrid]] and the [[Province of Ávila]], placing the [[Military Emergencies Unit]] in command. Authorities evacuate more than 10,000 people as three major fires remain uncontrolled. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/spain-declares-national-emergency-over-wildfires-in-madrid-region/4007647 (AA)]
*The death toll from the sinking of passenger [[ferry]] [[MV Barima|MV ''Barima'']] off the coast of [[Guyana]] two days ago rises to 72. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jul/24/guyana-coastal-ferry-sinking-deaths-rescue (The Guardian)] 
*Thirteen people are killed and two others are injured after a heavy boulder rolled down a hill and hit moving vehicles in [[Chamba District]], [[India]]. [https://english.news.cn/20260724/c486962112474583827ae752462154b6/c.html (Xinhua)]
*Five people are killed and three others are injured when a soil collapse buries a house in [[Hongtong County]], [[Shanxi]], [[China]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/five-people-killed-soil-collapse-northern-china-2026-07-25/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2026 Ebola epidemic]]
**[[University of Oxford|Oxford University]] reports the first volunteer that has been [[vaccination|injected]] with the [[Ebola vaccine|Ebola]] [[vaccine]] aimed at targeting the [[Bundibugyo ebolavirus|Bundibugyo]] [[ebolavirus]] strain of [[Ebola]] that is causing a outbreak in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/scitech/science/996075/first-person-vaccinated-during-trial-of-new-ebola-jab/story/ (AFP via GMA News Online)]
*[[2026 United States cyclosporiasis outbreak]]
**The U.S. [[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention]] (CDC) reports that the ongoing [[cyclosporiasis]] outbreak, which is caused by ''[[Cyclospora cayetanensis]]'', has spread to an additional four [[US state|states]]: [[Illinois]], [[Kansas]], [[Oklahoma]], and [[Pennsylvania]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/amp/2026/07/24/cyclospora-cdc-says-outbreak-is-in-nine-states.html (CNBC)]
**The U.S. state of [[Michigan]] surpasses 8,100 cases of cyclosporiasis. [https://www.cbsnews.com/detroit/news/michigan-cyclosporiasis-8100-cases/ (CBS News)]
*[[Dengue fever outbreaks]]
**The [[Sudan Doctors Union]] reports a [[dengue fever]] outbreak in [[Sudan]]'s [[Blue Nile State|Blue Nile]] [[States of Sudan|state]], killing 39 people and leaving 300 infected. [https://sudantribune.com/article/316569  (''Sudan Tribune'')]
*[[Measles resurgence in the United States]]
**The U.S. CDC reports 2,318 confirmed [[measles]] cases in the country during the first seven months of 2026, marking the highest annual total since 1991. [https://www.euractiv.com/news/us-measles-outbreak-hits-case-counts-not-seen-in-35-years/ (AFP via Euractiv)]

'''International relations'''
*[[International sanctions against Iran]]
**[[Iran–European Union relations]]
***The [[European Union]] [[European Union sanctions|sanctions]] five [[Judicial system of the Islamic Republic of Iran|Iranian judges]] over alleged [[Human rights in Iran|human rights]] violations and [[Ashiyane]] cyber group founder Nima Salehi, whom it accuses of cooperating with [[Government of Iran|Iranian authorities]] to [[Internet censorship in Iran|suppress information]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/eu-sanctions-iranian-judges-leading-cyber-group-figure-2026-07-24/ (Reuters)]
**[[United States sanctions against Iran]]
***The [[United States Department of the Treasury|U.S. treasury department]] announces [[United States government sanctions|sanctions]] against nine firms and four people associated with sanctioned Iranian financer [[Babak Zanjani]] after attempting to evade previous sanctions. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/us-hits-network-iranian-financier-zanjani-with-more-sanctions-2026-07-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[International Criminal Court investigation in Venezuela]]
**[[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Venezuela)|Venezuelan foreign minister]] [[Félix Plasencia]] says [[Venezuela|the country]] will withdraw from the [[International Criminal Court]] (ICC), citing alleged geographic bias. The ICC says it has not received formal notice and that existing investigations and cooperation obligations remain unaffected. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20260724-venezuela-to-withdraw-from-international-criminal-court (AFP via RFI)]
*[[Mexico–United States relations]], [[Mexican war on drugs]]
**The [[U.S. state department]], in coordination with the [[Secretariat of Finance and Public Credit|Mexican finance ministry]], sanctions over 50 [[Mexico|Mexican]] individuals and companies allegedly linked to the [[Jalisco New Generation Cartel]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-07-23/us-sanctions-mexican-cartel-leader-in-sweeping-drug-crackdown (Bloomberg)] [https://english.elpais.com/international/2026-07-23/us-treasury-and-mexican-authorities-deliver-their-biggest-blow-yet-to-the-jalisco-cartel-including-el-menchos-stepson.html (''El País'')]
